description:
Maintainer direction 2026-08-11. HTR-10 core physics is to be built as a reproducible multifidelity pipeline in which EACH RUNG IS VALIDATED AGAINST THE RUNG ABOVE IT, not four unrelated codes.

  meshing -> [1] rigorous Monte Carlo (outram-mc-libs/pebble_beds)
          -> [2] MGXS generation
          -> [3] deterministic multiphysics (GeN-Foam, decided over bedok)
          -> [4] PRKE + decay heat (teh-o-prke)

SCOPING DOCUMENT: docs/reactor-scoping/htr10-neutronics.md - read it before starting any child. It carries the benchmark definitions, the capability audit with file:line evidence, the hand-off data at each interface, the validation chain, the blockers and the ordered plan.

TWO HARD ARCHITECTURAL CONSTRAINTS:
1. REPRODUCIBLE. Every hand-off is an on-disk artefact with provenance; every run writes a manifest (workspace commit, XS library + version, fidelity tier, MC seed, particle/generation counts, group structure, homogenisation choice, mesh + its generation parameters); MC is bit-identical for a fixed seed; the chain is drivable headlessly.
2. FRONTEND-DRIVABLE. Entry point takes a geometry description plus a run configuration, so outram-blender can drive it as a third solver bridge (op-hzs.53). Not test-only.

VALIDATION CHAIN, every comparison quoted in pcm WITH the MC statistical uncertainty:
- rung 2/3 k_eff vs rung 1 k_eff on the same problem
- rung 4 beta_eff / Lambda / reactivity coefficients vs those collapsed directly from the rung 3 flux
- whole chain vs IAEA-TECDOC-1382 B1/B2/B3/B4 and the measured 123.06 cm loading

DO NOT report a k_eff, a pcm discrepancy or a beta_eff that was not computed. Nothing here is validated.
title: HTR-10 neutronics: multifidelity pipeline (MC -> MGXS -> GeN-Foam -> PRKE)

description:
MAINTAINER DECISION 2026-08-04: port the MFront generator, rather than
hand-porting the 14 MFront-declared laws.

This OVERRIDES the scoping document's recommendation (docs/code-aster-port-scoping.md
section 8 question 1), which argued for hand-porting on the grounds that the
.mfront DSL is declarative and reads close to the equations, while the generator
is a C++ code generator plus its type system and is unbounded relative to the 14
laws that motivate it.

Because the decision went the other way, this needs its OWN scoping pass before
any code is written -- it is a separate porting project, not a phase of the law
port. Scope it before P6 and do not fold it into a law-porting phase.

Payoff: any future MFront-declared law arrives free once the generator exists.
title: code_aster: scope the MFront generator port (maintainer chose generator over hand-porting 14 laws)

description: Idea (logged 2026-07-22, outside working hours — not started). Give njoy-outram-park-fork a ratatui TUI in the spirit of IAEA JANIS: browse/inspect the crate's nuclear data — pointwise cross sections sigma(E) per MT, resonance parameters, nu-bar/chi, thermal S(alpha,beta), WMP/MGXS blobs — with plots/tables in the terminal. Human-facing companion to the agent-facing data path. Precedent: kovan-tui (ratatui, Android-gated to a CLI stub). Must follow the workspace Android/Termux rule (ratatui TUI is in-scope for Android; target-gate any desktop-only bits). Design + scope TBD in an active window.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content: REQUIREMENTS (2026-07-22): MOBILE-FIRST ratatui TUI, interactable via TOUCHSCREEN (Termux/Android tap + scroll, not keyboard-only). Features: (1) fuzzy finder for nuclides (type to filter Z/A/symbol); (2) visualize cross sections on a LOG-LOG scale (sigma(E) vs E); (3) when selecting a cross section, let the user specify TEMPERATURE in either degrees C or Kelvin (unit toggle) -> Doppler-broadened XS at that T. JANIS-like data browser feel. Android/Termux rule: TUI is in-scope for Android; target-gate any desktop-only bits.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content: njoy-tui crate landed + pushed (mobile-first touchscreen ratatui, runs on Termux): fuzzy finder + log-log XS plot + degC/K temperature. 29/29 tests, Android target builds. Children op-ixe/op-1lj/op-dzl closed; shared touch layer op-omf implemented on the njoy side (outram-mc side pending in op-z5q).

title: njoy: JANIS-like TUI for browsing nuclear data

description: User request (2026-07-24): a Blender-inspired egui GUI to author geometry and set up + run BASIC outram-mc Monte Carlo simulations. Scope sketch: (1) reuse outram-blender surface/CSG authoring; (2) panel to define materials + assign to regions, source definition, tallies, batches/particles, k-eigenvalue vs fixed-source; (3) drive outram-mc-libs (CSG geometry, pull XS from njoy-outram-park-fork); (4) run + show k_eff / tally results; offline demonstration only per RESPONSIBLE_USE.md (education/research/V&V, NOT reactor operation). egui/eframe is GUI => target-gated OFF Android (windowing exemption), like outram-park-digital-twin-engine. Relate to op-hzs.38 (blender authoring GUI) — this adds the outram-mc simulation-setup half. Needs scoping/plan-mode before building.
title: outram-blender GUI: set up & run basic outram-mc simulations (egui)
